captions.caption: A car sits in a thick orange haze caused by smoke in Yakutia.
Smoke from wildfires creates a dense orange fog across the landscape.
The sun is barely visible as a bright spot through heavy orange smoke.
A dark orange sky is filled with thick smoke, obscuring visibility.
Silhouetted power lines are seen against a dark, smoke-filled orange sky.
A city street is heavily obscured by a thick greyish-brown haze.
Dense dust or smoke limits visibility in a residential area.
A hand points toward the horizon through a thick, murky haze.
The finger continues to point into the dense, greyish-brown dust.
A blurred shape, likely a vehicle, is seen through heavy haze.
A white car is partially visible in the distance through thick dust.
Visibility is extremely low as dust or smoke covers the area.
A large fire burns near buildings and trees in an urban area.
Intense flames and black smoke rise from a wildfire next to a road.
Smoke fills the air as fire consumes vegetation near residential structures.
The fire spreads through trees and bushes close to a street.
Thick grey smoke billows from burning debris on the ground.
Glowing embers and flames are visible through a screen of smoke.
An aerial view shows scorched ground and active fire under smoke.
Fire burns intensely in a small patch of ground vegetation.
A helicopter flies through smoke to assist in firefighting efforts.
The helicopter is silhouetted against a smoke-filled sky near an overpass.
Fire burns near the base of a concrete structure with a helicopter above.
Flames consume dry grass and bushes beneath a highway overpass.
Smoke and fire continue to spread in the area under the overpass.
A firefighter sprays water onto a burnt and smoldering structure.
The firefighter uses a hose to douse the remains of a charred building.
Close-up of a firefighter's helmet as they spray water on the fire.
Water from a hose hits charred wood, creating steam and smoke.
The firefighter directs water at hotspots in the burnt rubble.
A vehicle drives through a snowy landscape in Magadan, Russia.
Windshield wipers clear heavy snow from a car's front window.
The view from the car shows a white, snow-covered road and terrain.
The car continues along a road blanketed in deep snow.
Snow covers the landscape as far as the eye can see.
Windshield wipers work continuously to keep the view clear in the snow.
A person stands in a wide field covered in a thick layer of snow.
The snowy ground is shown with dark rocks poking through.
The camera pans across a desolate, snow-covered rocky area.
A close-up view of the snow-covered ground and small rocks.
The camera sweeps over the white, snow-covered landscape.
Snowflakes fall against a backdrop of a snow-laden hill.
The entire landscape is white, covered by a significant snowfall.
Heavy rain and hail fall on a green lawn in Texas.
Large hailstones bounce off the grass during a severe storm.
The storm creates a chaotic scene with hail and rain in a backyard.
A tree sways violently in the wind during the heavy rain and hail.
White hailstones cover the ground as the storm intensifies.
Rain lashes down on a suburban street, reducing visibility.
Trees bend under the force of wind and heavy rain and hail.
A house is obscured by a thick curtain of falling rain and hail.
The intensity of the downpour and hail is seen from a window.
Large hailstones accumulate on a wet driveway or patio.
Heavy rain floods the ground, mixing with the fallen hail.
Hailstones splash into pools of water on the ground.
The violent storm continues to lash the neighborhood with rain and hail.
Hailstones hit the wet pavement and bounce during the storm.
The ground is covered with a layer of white hailstones and water.
A flooded street in Bisha, Saudi Arabia, is shown during a storm.
Cars drive through deep water on a flooded city street.
